ValidationRule.description: Forces entry for Instrument Name only when a relevant consumable type is selected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( Instrument_Name__c ) , OR( ISPICKVAL( Consumable_Type__c , "Cartridge"), ISPICKVAL( Consumable_Type__c , "Accessory") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Instrument Name is required when ordering a Cartridge or Accessory.
